ns2:section.sectionText: Course meets Saturdays from January 22 through March 12. Registration restricted to dietetics and hospitality management majors only. Seats will be open to all FSHN majors and minors (minors must contact the department office (333-1324) for authorization to register) after junior registration. Any remaining seats will be released to the general student population at the end of freshman registration. TO BE ADDED TO A WAIT LIST FOR THIS CLASS, go to www.fshn.illinois.edu and click on Info for Current Students then "Waitlist Information"
